sentences.zh: 同光二年夏五月己亥，帝御文明殿，冊齊王張全義為太尉。

translations.literal: Summer, fifth month, jihai, Tongguang year 2: the Emperor took Wengming Hall to invest Prince of Qi Zhang Quanyi as Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai in summer of Tongguang 2 Cunxu invested Zhang Quanyi as Prince of Qi and Grand Preceptor at Wengming Hall.

sentences.zh: 禮畢，全義赴尚書省領事，左諫議大夫竇專不降階，為御史所劾，專援引舊典，宰相不能詰，寢而不行。

translations.literal: When the rite was done Quanyi went to the Directorate to take up office; Left Remonstrance Councillor Dou Zhuan did not descend the steps, was impeached by the censorate, cited old precedent, and the chief ministers could not rebut it—the matter was shelved.
translations.idiomatic: After the rite Quanyi took office at the Directorate; Dou Zhuan refused to step down and was impeached; citing precedent, he left the ministers unable to answer and the case died.

sentences.zh: 庚子，太常卿李燕卒。

translations.literal: On gengzi Director of Ceremonies Li Yan died.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi Li Yan, Director of Ceremonies, died.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，以教坊使陳俊為景州刺史，內園使儲德源為憲州刺史，皆梁之伶人也。

translations.literal: On renyin Chen Jun, commissioner of the Music Bureau, was made Jing prefect, and Chude Yuan, commissioner of the Inner Gardens, Xian prefect—both were Liang actor-retainers.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Chen Jun of the Music Bureau became Jing prefect and Chude Yuan of the Inner Gardens Xian prefect—both Liang actors.

sentences.zh: 初，帝平梁，俊與德源皆為寵伶周匝所薦，帝因許除郡，郭崇韜以為不可，伶官言之者眾，帝密召崇韜謂之曰：「予已許除郡，經年未行，我慚見二人，卿當屈意行之。

translations.literal: Earlier, when the Emperor had pacified Liang, Jun and Deyuan had both been recommended by his favored actor Zhou Zha; he had promised them prefectures; Guo Chongtao held it impossible, yet many actor-officials spoke for it; the Emperor secretly summoned Chongtao and said, "I already promised them prefectures and for a year have not acted—I am ashamed to face the two of them; you must bend your will and carry it out.
translations.idiomatic: When Cunxu conquered Liang, Zhou Zha had recommended Jun and Deyuan for posts; Cunxu had promised them commands but Guo Chongtao objected; many actors pressed the case; Cunxu secretly told Guo, "I promised them prefectures a year ago and am ashamed to face them—humor me.

sentences.zh: 」故有是命。

translations.literal: " Hence this order.
translations.idiomatic: " Hence these appointments.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，以兗州節度使李紹欽依前檢校太保、兗州節度使，進封開國侯；

translations.literal: On jiachen Yanzhou military commissioner Li Shaoqin remained acting Grand Guardian and Yanzhou commissioner and was advanced to Marquis Who Opens the State;
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen Li Shaoqin of Yanzhou kept his Grand Guardian and Yanzhou posts and was made Marquis Who Opens the State;

sentences.zh: 以邠州節度使韓恭依前檢校太保、邠州節度使，進封開國伯。

translations.literal: Binzhou military commissioner Han Gong remained acting Grand Guardian and Binzhou commissioner and was advanced to Earl Who Opens the State.
translations.idiomatic: Han Gong of Binzhou kept his posts and was made Earl Who Opens the State.

sentences.zh: 丙午，以福建節度使、閩王王審知依前檢校太師、守中書令、福建節度使。

translations.literal: On bingwu Fujian military commissioner and King of Min Wang Shenzhi remained acting Grand Preceptor, Defender of the Secretariat, and Fujian commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu Wang Shenzhi of Min kept Grand Preceptor, Secretariat, and Fujian posts.

sentences.zh: 戊申，幸郭崇韜第。

translations.literal: On wushen the Emperor visited Guo Chongtao's residence.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen Cunxu visited Guo Chongtao's home.

sentences.zh: 己酉，詔天下收拆防城之具，不得修浚池隍。

translations.literal: On jiyou an edict ordered all under heaven to collect and dismantle city-defense equipment and forbade repairing or dredging moats.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou an edict ordered the realm to dismantle defensive gear and banned moat repairs.

sentences.zh: 以西都留守、京兆尹張筠依前檢校太保，充西都留守。

translations.literal: Western Capital regent and Jingzhao prefect Zhang Jun remained acting Grand Guardian and was confirmed as Western Capital regent.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Jun of the Western Capital kept Grand Guardian and stayed regent of the western capital.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，以滄州節度使李紹斌充東北面招討使，以兗州節度李紹欽為副招討使，以宣徽使李紹宏為招討都監，率大軍渡河而北，時幽州上言契丹將寇河朔故也。

translations.literal: On jiayin Cangzhou military commissioner Li Shaobin was made northeastern campaign commander, Yanzhou commissioner Li Shaoqin deputy commander, and Bureau of Palace Affairs commissioner Li Shaohong campaign supervisor, leading a great army across the river northward—at that time Youzhou had reported that the Khitan would raid Hebei, hence this.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin Li Shaobin of Cangzhou led a northern campaign with Li Shaoqin of Yanzhou as deputy and Li Shaohong as supervisor, crossing the river because Youzhou reported Khitan raids on Hebei.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，潞州叛將楊立遣使健步奉表乞行赦宥，帝令樞密副使宋唐玉齎敕書招撫。

translations.literal: On yimao Luzhou rebel commander Yang Li sent a fast courier with a memorial begging amnesty; the Emperor ordered Bureau of Military Affairs vice commissioner Song Tangyu to carry an edict to win him over.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao Yang Li of Luzhou sent a swift memorial asking pardon; Cunxu sent Song Tangyu with an edict to pacify him.

sentences.zh: 幽州上言，契丹營於州東南。

translations.literal: Youzhou reported that the Khitan were encamped southeast of the prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Youzhou said the Khitan were camped southeast of the city.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，渤海國王大諲撰遣使貢方物。

translations.literal: On bingchen the Great King of Bohai Da Yinzhuan sent envoys with regional tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen King Da Yinzhuan of Bohai sent tribute envoys.

sentences.zh: 以澶州刺史李審益為幽州行軍司馬、蕃漢內外都知兵馬使。

translations.literal: Cang prefect Li Shenyi was made Youzhou campaign marshal and overseer of Han and non-Han forces within and without.
translations.idiomatic: Li Shenyi of Cang was made Youzhou campaign marshal overseeing all Han and foreign troops.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，故澤潞節度使丁會贈太師。

translations.literal: On xinyou the late Ze-Lu military commissioner Ding Hui was posthumously made Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou the late Ding Hui of Ze-Lu was posthumously made Grand Preceptor.

sentences.zh: 詔割復州為荊南屬郡。

translations.literal: An edict detached Fuzhou as a subordinate prefecture of Jingnan.
translations.idiomatic: Fuzhou was transferred to Jingnan circuit.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，以權知鳳翔軍府事、涇州節度使李嚴為起復雲麾將軍、右金吾大將軍同正，依前檢校太尉、兼中書令，充鳳翔節度使。

translations.literal: On renxu acting Fengxiang commander and Jingzhou military commissioner Li Yan was made restored Cloud-Banner general and Right Golden Brightness general with concurrent nominal rank, remaining acting Grand Guardian and Secretariat vice director, and confirmed as Fengxiang commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu Li Yan of Fengxiang was restored to office as Cloud-Banner and Golden Brightness general while keeping Grand Guardian, Secretariat, and Fengxiang posts.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，以權知歸義軍留後曹義金為歸義軍節度使、沙州刺史、檢校司空。

translations.literal: On yichou acting Guiyi Army regent Cao Yijin was made Guiyi military commissioner, Shazhou prefect, and acting Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou Cao Yijin was made Guiyi commissioner and Shazhou prefect with acting Minister of Works rank.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，李嗣源奏收復潞州。

translations.literal: On bingyin Li Siyuan memorialized that Luzhou had been recovered.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin Li Siyuan reported Luzhou retaken.

sentences.zh: 幽州上言，新授宣武軍節度使李存審卒。

translations.literal: Youzhou reported that the newly appointed Xuanyang military commissioner Li Cunshen had died.
translations.idiomatic: Youzhou said Li Cunshen, newly named Xuanyang commissioner, had died.

sentences.zh: 六月甲戌，中書侍郎兼吏部尚書、平章事、宏文館大學士豆盧革加右僕射，餘如故；

translations.literal: Sixth month, jiaxu: Secretariat vice director concurrent Minister of Personnel, chief minister, and Hongwen Academy university scholar Dou Luge was made Right Vice Director, with the rest as before;
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on jiaxu Dou Luge gained Right Vice Director while keeping chief minister and Hongwen posts;

sentences.zh: 侍中、監修國史、兼樞密使、鎮州節度使郭崇韜進爵邑，加功臣號；

translations.literal: Palace Attendant, chief editor of state history, concurrent Bureau of Military Affairs commissioner and Zhenzhou military commissioner Guo Chongtao advanced in noble rank and fief and received a merit title;
translations.idiomatic: Guo Chongtao gained noble rank, an enlarged fief, and a merit title;

sentences.zh: 中書侍郎、平章事、集賢殿大學士趙光裔加兼戶部尚書；

translations.literal: Secretariat vice director, chief minister, and Hall of Assembled Worthies university scholar Zhao Guangyi was made concurrent Minister of Revenue;
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Guangyi also became Minister of Revenue;

sentences.zh: 禮部侍郎、平章事韋說加中書侍郎。

translations.literal: Vice Minister of Rites and chief minister Wei Yue was made Secretariat vice director.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Yue became Secretariat vice director.

sentences.zh: 宋州奏，節度使李紹安卒。

translations.literal: Songzhou reported that military commissioner Li Shao'an had died.
translations.idiomatic: Songzhou said commissioner Li Shao'an had died.

sentences.zh: 丙子，李嗣源遣使部送潞州叛將楊立等到闕，並磔於市。

translations.literal: On bingzi Li Siyuan sent envoys escorting Luzhou rebel Yang Li and others to court, and they were all torn apart at the market.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi Li Siyuan sent Yang Li and the Luzhou rebels to court; all were torn apart in the market.

sentences.zh: 潞州城峻而隍深，至是帝命剗平之，因詔諸方鎮撤防城之備焉。

translations.literal: Luzhou's walls were high and its moat deep; now the Emperor ordered them leveled, and by edict the various circuits were to remove city defenses.
translations.idiomatic: Luzhou's high walls and deep moat were razed on Cunxu's order, and circuits were told to dismantle defenses.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，有司上言：「洛陽已建宗廟，其北京太廟請停。

translations.literal: On dingchou the relevant office memorialized: "Luoyang already has an Imperial Temple; the northern capital's Grand Temple should be discontinued.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou the rites office said Luoyang's temple was enough and the northern capital's temple should close.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " It was approved.
translations.idiomatic: " Approved.

sentences.zh: 甲申，以衛國夫人韓氏為淑妃，燕國夫人伊氏為德妃，仍令所司擇日冊命。

translations.literal: On jiashen Lady Han of Wei state was made Shufei, Lady Yi of Yan state Defei, and the relevant office was ordered to choose a day for full investiture.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen Lady Han became Shufei and Lady Yi Defei, with days set for investiture.

sentences.zh: 故河東節度副使、守左諫議大夫李襲吉贈禮部尚書；

translations.literal: The late Hedong deputy commissioner and Defender of the Left Remonstrance Li Xiji was posthumously made Minister of Rites;
translations.idiomatic: The late Li Xiji of Hedong was posthumously made Minister of Rites;

sentences.zh: 故河東節度副使、禮部尚書蘇循贈左僕射；

translations.literal: the late Hedong deputy commissioner and Minister of Rites Su Xun was posthumously made Left Vice Director;
translations.idiomatic: the late Su Xun of Hedong Left Vice Director;

sentences.zh: 故河東觀察判官、檢校右僕射司馬揆贈司空；

translations.literal: the late Hedong observation judge and acting Right Vice Director Sima Kui was posthumously made Minister of Works;
translations.idiomatic: Sima Kui of Hedong Minister of Works;

sentences.zh: 故河東留守判官、工部尚書李敬義贈右僕射。

translations.literal: the late Hedong regent judge and Minister of Works Li Jingyi was posthumously made Right Vice Director.
translations.idiomatic: and Li Jingyi of Hedong Right Vice Director.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，以順義軍節度使李令錫為許州節度使，以前保義軍留後李紹真為徐州節度使，以徐州節度使李紹榮為宋州節度使。

translations.literal: On bingxu Shunyi military commissioner Li Lingxi was made Xu military commissioner; former Baoyi regent Li Shaozhen was made Xuzhou military commissioner; and Xuzhou military commissioner Li Shaorong was made Song military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Li Lingxi took Xu, Li Shaozhen Xuzhou, and Li Shaorong Song.

sentences.zh: 戊子，汝州防禦使張繼孫賜死於本郡。

translations.literal: On wuzi Ruzhou defender Zhang Jisun was ordered to die in his own prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi Zhang Jisun of Ruzhou was ordered to die in his circuit.

sentences.zh: 繼孫即齊王張全義之假子也，本姓郝氏，為兄繼業等訟其陰事，故誅之。

translations.literal: Jisun was the adopted son of Prince of Qi Zhang Quanyi, originally surnamed Hao; his elder brother Jiye and others sued him for secret crimes, hence the execution.
translations.idiomatic: Jisun was Quanyi's adopted son, born Hao; his brother Jiye exposed secret crimes, so he was killed.

translations.literal: 〈Bracket note
translations.idiomatic: 〈Note

sentences.zh: （《冊府元龜》載：張繼業為河陽兩使留後。

translations.literal: (The 《Prime Tortoise of the Imperial Archives》 records: Zhang Jiye was regent of the two He-Yang commissions.
translations.idiomatic: (The 《Prime Tortoise of the Imperial Archives》 says Zhang Jiye was He-Yang regent.

sentences.zh: 莊宗同光二年六月，繼業上疏稱：「弟繼孫，本姓郝，有母尚在，父全義養為假子，令管衙內兵士。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of Tongguang 2 Zhuangzong, Jiye memorialized: "My younger brother Jisun, originally surnamed Hao, still has a mother living; Father Quanyi raised him as an adopted son and put him in charge of the yamen guard.
translations.idiomatic: In Tongguang 2, sixth month, Jiye wrote, "My brother Jisun, born Hao, still has a mother; Quanyi adopted him and gave him the yamen guard.

sentences.zh: 自皇帝到京，繼孫私藏兵甲，招置部曲，欲圖不軌，兼私家淫縱，無別無義。

translations.literal: Since the Emperor reached the capital Jisun has secretly stored arms and armor, recruited followers, and plotted rebellion; he also indulged in private lust without restraint or duty.
translations.idiomatic: Since the court came to the capital he has hoarded arms, recruited men, and plotted rebellion, and indulged in lust without duty.

sentences.zh: 臣若不自陳，恐累家族。

translations.literal: If I do not report myself I fear harm to the clan."
translations.idiomatic: If I do not speak out I fear for the family."

sentences.zh: 」敕曰：「有善必賞，所以勸忠孝之方；

translations.literal: An edict said: "Good must be rewarded, to encourage the path of loyalty and filial piety;
translations.idiomatic: An edict read, "Good must be rewarded to encourage loyalty and filial piety;

sentences.zh: 有惡必誅，所以絕奸邪之跡。

translations.literal: evil must be punished, to cut off the traces of treachery.
translations.idiomatic: evil must be punished to cut off treachery.

sentences.zh: 其或罪狀騰於眾口，醜行布於近親，須舉朝章，冀明國法。

translations.literal: When crimes are shouted by the multitude and foul conduct spreads among close kin, the court code must be invoked to clarify state law.
translations.idiomatic: When crimes are public and kin are shamed, state law must clarify the case.

sentences.zh: 汝州防禦使張繼孫，本非張氏子孫，自小丐養，以至成立，備極顯榮，而不能酬撫育之恩，履謙恭之道，擅行威福，常恣奸凶，侵奪父權，惑亂家事，縱鳥獸之行，畜梟獍之心，有識者所不忍言，無賴者實為其黨。

translations.literal: Ruzhou defender Zhang Jisun was not born of the Zhang clan; from childhood he was begged and raised to full standing, given the utmost glory, yet could not repay fostering kindness or walk the path of humility; he wielded power at will, constantly indulged wickedness, usurped his father's authority, and confused the household; he practiced the conduct of birds and beasts and harbored the heart of an owl—those with understanding could not bear to speak of it, and the lawless were his party.
translations.idiomatic: Ruzhou defender Zhang Jisun, not a Zhang by birth but raised from a beggar child to glory, repaid kindness with arrogance, seized his father's power, confused the house, and behaved like beasts with an owl's heart—honest men were silenced and rogues were his gang.

sentences.zh: 而又橫征暴斂，虐法峻刑，藏兵器於私家，殺平人於廣陌。

translations.literal: Moreover he levied harshly and punished cruelly, hid weapons in his home, and killed commoners in the open road.
translations.idiomatic: He also taxed harshly, punished cruelly, hid arms at home, and killed people in the street.

sentences.zh: 罔思悛改，難議矜容，宜竄逐於遐方，仍歸還於姓氏，俾我勳賢之族，永除汙穢之風。

translations.literal: He gave no thought to reform and could not be shown mercy; he should be banished to a distant place and his surname restored, that our meritorious clans may forever be rid of this foul wind.
translations.idiomatic: Unrepentant and unworthy of mercy, he should be exiled and his surname restored so meritorious families are rid of this stain.

sentences.zh: 凡百臣僚，宜體朕命。

translations.literal: Let all officials embody my command.
translations.idiomatic: Let all officials heed this command.

sentences.zh: 可貶房州司戶參軍同正，兼勒復本姓。

translations.literal: He is demoted to acting registrar of Fang prefecture with concurrent restoration of his original surname."
translations.idiomatic: He is demoted to Fang registrar and must resume his original surname."

sentences.zh: 」尋賜自盡，仍籍沒資產。）〉

translations.literal: Soon he was ordered to take his own life and his property was confiscated.)〉
translations.idiomatic: He was soon ordered to die and his goods were seized.)〉

sentences.zh: 己丑，以回鶻可汗仁美為英義可汗。

translations.literal: On jichou the Uyghur khagan Ren Mei was made Illustrious Righteous Khagan.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou Uyghur khagan Ren Mei was named Illustrious Righteous Khagan.

sentences.zh: 詔改輝州為單州。

translations.literal: An edict changed Hui prefecture to Shan prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Hui prefecture was renamed Shan.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，故左僕射裴樞，右僕射裴贄、崔遠並贈司徒；

translations.literal: On gengyin the late Left Vice Director Pei Shu, Right Vice Director Pei Zan, and Cui Yuan were all posthumously made Grand Mentor;
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin the late Pei Shu, Pei Zan, and Cui Yuan were posthumously made Grand Mentor;

sentences.zh: 故靜海軍節度使獨孤損贈司空；

translations.literal: the late Jinghai military commissioner Dugu Sun was posthumously made Minister of Works;
translations.idiomatic: Dugu Sun of Jinghai Minister of Works;

sentences.zh: 故吏部尚書陸扆贈右僕射；

translations.literal: the late Minister of Personnel Lu Yi was posthumously made Right Vice Director;
translations.idiomatic: Lu Yi of Personnel Right Vice Director;

sentences.zh: 故工部尚書王溥贈右僕射。

translations.literal: the late Minister of Works Wang Pu was posthumously made Right Vice Director.
translations.idiomatic: and Wang Pu of Works Right Vice Director.

sentences.zh: 裴樞等六人皆前朝宰輔，為梁祖所害於白馬驛，至是追贈焉。

translations.literal: Pei Shu and the other six had all been chief ministers of the former dynasty and were killed by the Liang founder at Baima Post; now they were posthumously honored.
translations.idiomatic: All six had been Tang chief ministers killed by the Liang founder at Baima Post and were now posthumously honored.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，以天平軍節度使、蕃漢總管副使、開府儀同三司、檢校太尉、兼中書令李嗣源為宣武軍節度使、蕃漢馬步總管，餘如故。

translations.literal: On renchen Tianping military commissioner, Han and non-Han deputy chief, Acting Grand Guardian, and Secretariat vice director Li Siyuan was made Xuanyang military commissioner and Han and non-Han horse-and-foot chief, with the rest as before.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen Li Siyuan of Tianping became Xuanyang commissioner and Han and non-Han chief while keeping his other posts.

sentences.zh: 甲午，以樞密使、特進、左領軍衛上將軍、知內侍省事張居翰為驃騎大將軍、守左驍衛上將軍，進封開國伯，賜功臣號。

translations.literal: On jiawu Bureau of Military Affairs commissioner, Special Counselor, Left Leading Army general, and director of inner palace affairs Zhang Juhun was made Cavalry general-in-chief and Defender of the Left Martial Tiger general, advanced to Earl Who Opens the State, and granted a merit title.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu Zhang Juhun became Cavalry general-in-chief and Left Martial Tiger defender, was made Earl Who Opens the State, and received a merit title.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊戌朔，故宣武軍節度使李存審男彥超進其父牙兵八千七百人。

translations.literal: Seventh month, wuxu new moon: the late Xuanyang military commissioner Li Cunshen's son Yanchao presented his father's personal guard of eight thousand seven hundred men.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu new moon of the seventh month Yanchao presented his late father Li Cunshen's guard of 8,700 men.

sentences.zh: 己亥，中書門下奏：「每年南郊壇四祠祭，太微宮五薦獻，並宰臣攝太尉行事，惟太廟遣庶僚行事，此後太廟祠祭，亦望差宰臣行事。

translations.literal: On jihai the Secretariat memorialized: "Each year at the southern altar the four shrine offerings and at Taiwei Palace the five presentations are all performed by chief ministers acting as libationer; only the Imperial Temple sends junior officials—hereafter Imperial Temple offerings should also be assigned to chief ministers."
translations.idiomatic: On jihai the Secretariat asked that temple rites, like altar and Taiwei offerings, be performed by chief ministers rather than junior staff.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " It was approved.
translations.idiomatic: " Approved.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，汴州雍丘縣大風，拔木傷稼。

translations.literal: On yisi Yongqiu county in Bianzhou had a great wind that uprooted trees and damaged crops.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi Yongqiu in Bianzhou had a wind that uprooted trees and ruined crops.

sentences.zh: 曹州大雨，平地水三尺。

translations.literal: Caozhou had heavy rain and three feet of water on level ground.
translations.idiomatic: Caozhou flooded three feet deep on level ground.

sentences.zh: 丙午，以襄州節度使孔為潞州節度使，李存霸為鄆州節度使。

translations.literal: On bingwu Xiang military commissioner Kong Wei was made Luzhou military commissioner, and Li Cunba was made Yan military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu Kong Wei took Xiang and Li Cunba Yan.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，幸龍門之雷山，祭天神，從北俗之舊事也。

translations.literal: On yiyou the Emperor went to Thunder Mountain at Longmen to sacrifice to Heaven—following the northern custom of old.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou Cunxu sacrificed at Thunder Mountain on Longmen, following a northern custom.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，以鄆州副使李紹珙為襄州留後，以前澤州刺史董璋為邠州留後。

translations.literal: On xinhai Yan deputy commissioner Li Shaogong was made Xiang regent; former Ze prefect Dong Zhang was made Bin regent.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai Li Shaogong became Xiang regent and Dong Zhang Bin regent.

sentences.zh: 戊午，西川王衍遣偽署戶部侍郎歐陽彬來朝貢，稱「大蜀皇帝上書大唐皇帝」。

translations.literal: On wuwu Shu ruler Wang Yan sent his false-appointed Vice Minister of Revenue Ouyang Bin to court with tribute, styling himself "Great Shu Emperor writing to the Great Tang Emperor."
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu Wang Yan of Shu sent Ouyang Bin as tribute envoy, signing as "Great Shu Emperor to Great Tang Emperor."

sentences.zh: 庚申，以應州為雲州屬郡，升新州為威塞軍節度使，以媯、儒、武等州為屬郡。

translations.literal: On gengshen Ying prefecture was made a subordinate of Yun prefecture; Xin was raised to Weisai military commissioner with Ji, Ru, and Wu as subordinates.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen Ying was attached to Yun and Xin became Weisai commissioner over Ji, Ru, and Wu.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，皇子繼岌妻王氏封魏國夫人。

translations.literal: On renxu the wife of Prince Jiji, Lady Wang, was enfeoffed as Lady of Wei state.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu Jiji's wife Lady Wang was made Lady of Wei state.

sentences.zh: 幽州奏，契丹安巴堅東攻渤海。

translations.literal: Youzhou reported that the Khitan Ambagyan was attacking Bohai eastward.
translations.idiomatic: Youzhou said Khitan leader Ambagyan was attacking Bohai in the east.

sentences.zh: 八月己巳，詔洛京應有隙地，任人請射修造，有主者限半年，令本主自修蓋，如過限不見屋宇，許他人占射。

translations.literal: Eighth month, jisi: an edict said that vacant land in Luoyang might be claimed for building; where there was an owner, half a year was allowed for the owner to build—if after the limit no structure appeared, others might claim it.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on jisi, vacant Luoyang land could be claimed for building; owners had half a year to build or others could take it.

translations.literal: 〈Bracket note
translations.idiomatic: 〈Note

sentences.zh: （《五代會要》載此詔云：藩方侯伯，內外臣僚，於京邑之中，無安居之所，亦可請射，各自修營。）〉

translations.literal: (The 《Institutions of the Five Dynasties》 records this edict: frontier lords and inner and outer officials who had no dwelling in the capital might also claim sites and build for themselves.)〉
translations.idiomatic: (The 《Institutions of the Five Dynasties》 adds that frontier lords and officials without capital homes could also claim and build.)〉

sentences.zh: 辛未，北京副留守、太原尹孟知祥加檢校太傅，增邑，賜功臣號。

translations.literal: On xinwei Beijing deputy regent and Taiyuan prefect Meng Zhixiang was made acting Grand Guardian, with added fief and a merit title.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei Meng Zhixiang of Taiyuan became acting Grand Guardian with added fief and a merit title.

sentences.zh: 帝畋於西苑。

translations.literal: The Emperor hunted in the Western Park.
translations.idiomatic: Cunxu hunted in the Western Park.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，以租庸副使、守衛尉卿孔謙為租庸使，以右威衛上將軍孔循為租庸副使。

translations.literal: On guiyou land-tax vice commissioner and acting Director of the Imperial Guard Kong Qian was made land-tax commissioner, and Right Martial Tiger general Kong Xun was made land-tax vice commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou Kong Qian became land-tax commissioner and Kong Xun his deputy.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，以權知汴州軍州事、翰林學士承旨、戶部尚書盧質為兵部尚書，依前翰林學士承旨，仍賜論思匡佐功臣。

translations.literal: On jiaxu acting Bian prefect, Hanlin Academician-in-Chief, and Minister of Revenue Lu Zhi was made Minister of War, remaining Hanlin Academician-in-Chief, and granted the merit title "Counsel in Reflection and Aid in Governance."
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu Lu Zhi of Bian became Minister of War while keeping Hanlin chief and gaining the merit title Counsel in Reflection and Aid in Governance.

sentences.zh: 丙子，以雲州刺史、雁門以北都知兵馬使安元信為大同軍節度留後，以隰州刺史張廷裕為新州威塞軍節度留後。

translations.literal: On bingzi Yun prefect and northern campaign overseer north of Yanmen An Yuanxin was made Datong military regent; Yin prefect Zhang Tingyu was made Weisai regent.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi An Yuanxin of Yun became Datong regent and Zhang Tingyu of Yin Weisai regent.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，樞密使郭崇韜上表請退，不允。

translations.literal: On dingchou Bureau of Military Affairs commissioner Guo Chongtao memorialized asking to retire; it was not granted.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou Guo Chongtao asked to resign the bureau post; Cunxu refused.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，租庸使、守禮部尚書王正言罷使，守本官。

translations.literal: On wuyin land-tax commissioner and acting Minister of Rites Wang Zhengyan was removed from the commission and kept his original office.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin Wang Zhengyan left the land-tax post but kept Minister of Rites.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，詔諸道節度、觀察、防禦、團練使、刺史，並於洛陽修宅一區。

translations.literal: On gengchen an edict ordered every circuit military commissioner, observer, defender, training commissioner, and prefect to build one residence in Luoyang.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen every commissioner and prefect was ordered to build a Luoyang residence.

sentences.zh: 中書門下上言：「請今後諸道除節度副使、兩使判官外，其餘職員並諸州軍事判官，各任本處奏辟。

translations.literal: The Secretariat memorialized: "Hereafter, except for deputy commissioners and the two commission judges, all other staff and military judges of the various prefectures should be recruited and memorialized by their own jurisdictions."
translations.idiomatic: The Secretariat asked that except for deputies and two commission judges, all staff and military judges be hired locally.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " It was approved.
translations.idiomatic: " Approved.

translations.literal: 〈Bracket note
translations.idiomatic: 〈Note

sentences.zh: （《五代會要》：同光二年八月八日，中書門下奏：「諸道除節度副使及兩使判官除授外，其餘職員並軍事判官，伏以翹車著詠，戔帛垂文，式重弓旌，以光尊俎。

translations.literal: (The 《Institutions of the Five Dynasties》: On the eighth day of the eighth month of Tongguang 2 the Secretariat memorialized: "Except for deputy commissioners and the two commission judges appointed by the court, all other staff and military judges—as the ode on the lofty carriage and the silk of the battle-axe show in writing, bow and banner are weighty to honor the feast.
translations.idiomatic: (The 《Institutions of the Five Dynasties》 on Tongguang 2, eighth month, eighth day: except for deputies and two commission judges appointed centrally, other staff and military judges—as the classics show, honored bows and banners dignify the feast.

sentences.zh: 由是副知已之薦，成接士之榮，必當備悉行藏，習知才行，允奉幕中之畫，以稱席上之珍。

translations.literal: Hence the deputy knows his recommender's glory in receiving scholars; he must fully know conduct and ability and serve the plan in the tent as a treasure at the table.
translations.idiomatic: Deputies should know their men's conduct and talent and serve as treasures in the tent.

sentences.zh: 爰自偽梁，頗乖斯義，皆從除授，以佐藩宣。

translations.literal: From the false Liang court this meaning was greatly lost—all were appointed by the center to assist the circuits.
translations.idiomatic: Under Liang this was lost and the center appointed everyone to the circuits.

sentences.zh: 因緣多事之秋，慮爽得人之選，將期推擇，式示更張。

translations.literal: In a season of many affairs we fear missing the right men and wish to choose anew and show reform.
translations.idiomatic: In troubled times the court feared poor choices and sought reform.

sentences.zh: 今後諸道，除節度副使、判官兩使除授外，其餘職員並諸州軍事判官等，並任本道本州，各當辟舉，其軍事判官，仍不在奏官之限。」）〉

translations.literal: Hereafter, except for deputy commissioners and the two commission judges appointed by the court, all other staff and military judges of circuits and prefectures should be recruited by their own circuit or prefecture; military judges are still outside the limit of court memorials."〉
translations.idiomatic: Henceforth circuits and prefectures should hire their own staff and military judges except for deputies and two commission judges; military judges need not be memorialized centrally."〉

sentences.zh: 汴州奏，大水損稼。

translations.literal: Bianzhou reported that floodwaters had damaged crops.
translations.idiomatic: Bianzhou reported flood damage to crops.

sentences.zh: 癸未，租庸使孔謙進封會稽縣男，仍賜豐財贍國功臣。

translations.literal: On guiwei land-tax commissioner Kong Qian was advanced to Baron of Kuaiji and granted the merit title "Enriching the State with Wealth."
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei Kong Qian became Baron of Kuaiji with the merit title Enriching the State with Wealth.

sentences.zh: 淮南楊溥遣使貢方物。

translations.literal: Huainan's Yang Pu sent envoys with regional tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Pu of Huainan sent tribute envoys.

sentences.zh: 宋州大水，鄆、曹等州大風雨，損稼。

translations.literal: Songzhou had great floods; Yan and Cao had great wind and rain that damaged crops.
translations.idiomatic: Songzhou flooded; Yan and Cao had storms that ruined crops.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，中書門下侍郎奏：「請差左丞崔沂、吏部侍郎崔貽孫、給事中鄭韜光、李光序、吏部員外郎盧損等，同詳定選司長定格、循資格、十道圖。

translations.literal: On dinghai the Secretariat vice directors memorialized: "Please assign Left Vice Director Cui Yi, Vice Minister of Personnel Cui Yisun, Presentation Drafters Zheng Taoguang and Li Guangxu, and Personnel Vice Director Lu Sun, together to review in detail the Selection Bureau's long-form regulations, seniority rules, and Ten-Circuit Chart.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai the Secretariat asked Cui Yi, Cui Yisun, Zheng Taoguang, Li Guangxu, and Lu Sun to review the Selection Bureau regulations, seniority rules, and Ten-Circuit Chart.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " It was approved.
translations.idiomatic: " Approved.

translations.literal: 〈Bracket note
translations.idiomatic: 〈Note

sentences.zh: （《五代會要》：同光二年八月，中書門下奏：「吏部三銓、門下省、南曹、廢置、甲庫、格式、流外銓等司公事，並係長定格、循資格、十道圖等，前件格文，本朝創立，檢製奸濫，倫敘官資頗謂精詳，久同遵守。

translations.literal: (The 《Five Dynasties Institutes》: In the eighth month of Tongguang 2 the Secretariat and Chancellery memorialized: "The regular business of the three selection boards of Personnel, the Secretariat Gate, the Southern Office, appointments and dismissals, the roster office, formats, and the external-selection office all concern the standing rules, sequential qualifications, and Ten Circuits chart; the foregoing regulations were created by this dynasty to check fraud and ordering official rank has been considered quite precise, long observed alike.
translations.idiomatic: (The 《Five Dynasties Institutes》 says in the eighth month of Tongguang 2 the Secretariat reported, "Personnel's three boards, the Secretariat Gate, the Southern Office, appointments and dismissals, the roster office, formats, and external selection all rest on standing rules, sequential qualifications, and the Ten Circuits chart—rules this dynasty made to curb fraud and order rank, long and precisely observed.

sentences.zh: 自亂離之後，巧偽滋多，兼同光元年八月，車駕在東京，權判工部員外郎盧重《本司起請》一卷，並以興復之始，務切懷來，凡有條流，多失根本，以至冬集赴選人，並南郊行事官，及陪位宗子共一千三百餘人，銓曹檢勘之時，互有援引，去留之際，不絕爭論，若又依違，必長訛濫。

translations.literal: Since the turmoil fraud has multiplied; moreover in the eighth month of Tongguang 1, when the imperial carriage was at the Eastern Capital, acting Vice Director of Works Lu Chong submitted one roll of 《Petition from This Office》, all because at the start of restoration they sought to win people over—wherever there were articles many lost their root—until at the winter assembly those coming for selection, officers for the southern suburb rites, and attending imperial clansmen together exceeded thirteen hundred; when the selection office examined them each cited precedents, and at the decision on who stayed or went disputes never ceased—if again followed loosely, abuse would surely grow.
translations.idiomatic: After the chaos fraud spread; in Tongguang 1, eighth month, at the Eastern Capital acting Works vice director Lu Chong filed a 《Petition from This Office》 roll—in restoration's first rush to win hearts many rules lost their root—so at the winter assembly candidates, southern-suburb officers, and attending imperial clansmen topped thirteen hundred; the selection office found endless precedent-citing and quarrels over who stayed; lax enforcement would only deepen abuse.

sentences.zh: 望差權判尚書省銓左丞崔沂、吏部侍郎崔貽孫、給事中鄭韜光、李光序、吏部員外郎盧損等，同詳定舊長定格、循資格、十道圖，務令簡要，可久施行。

translations.literal: We ask that Acting Left Director of the Secretariat selection office Cui Yi, Vice Minister of Personnel Cui Yisun, Attendants-in-ordinary Zheng Taoguang and Li Guangxu, and Personnel Vice Director Lu Sun be assigned together to review the old standing rules, sequential qualifications, and Ten Circuits chart, making them concise and workable for long implementation.
translations.idiomatic: We ask Acting Secretariat selection director Cui Yi, Personnel vice minister Cui Yisun, attendants-in-ordinary Zheng Taoguang and Li Guangxu, and Personnel vice director Lu Sun jointly to revise the standing rules, sequential qualifications, and Ten Circuits chart into something brief and lasting."

translations.literal: 」It was followed.)〉
translations.idiomatic: 」The request was granted.)〉

sentences.zh: 癸巳，放朝參三日，以霖雨故也。

translations.literal: On guisi, court attendance was suspended for three days because of continuous rain.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi court was canceled three days for heavy rain.

sentences.zh: 陝州奏，河水溢岸。

translations.literal: Shaanxi prefecture memorialized that the Yellow River overflowed its banks.
translations.idiomatic: Shaanxi reported the Yellow River over its banks.

sentences.zh: 乙未，中書門下上言：「諸陵台令丞請停，以本縣令知陵台事。

translations.literal: On yiwei, the Secretariat and Chancellery submitted: "The directors and vice directors of the imperial tombs should be abolished; let the magistrate of the local county administer tomb affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei the Secretariat asked to abolish tomb directors and vice directors and let each county magistrate oversee the tombs.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: 」It was followed.
translations.idiomatic: 」The throne approved.

sentences.zh: 九月癸卯，畋於西北郊。

translations.literal: In the ninth month on guimao, the Emperor hunted in the northwest suburb.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month on guimao Cunxu hunted northwest of the city.

sentences.zh: 幽州上言，契丹安巴堅自渤海國回軍。

translations.literal: Youzhou reported that the Khitan Anbajian had returned his army from the Bohai state.
translations.idiomatic: Youzhou said the Khitan Anbajian was marching back from Bohai.

sentences.zh: 內園新殿成，名曰長春殿。

translations.literal: The inner garden's new hall was completed and named Everlasting Spring Hall.
translations.idiomatic: The inner garden's new hall was finished and named Everlasting Spring Hall.

sentences.zh: 戊申，以中書舍人、權知貢舉裴皞為禮部侍郎，以前鄭州防禦副使薑宏道為太僕卿。

translations.literal: On wushen, Secretariat drafter and acting director of the examinations Pei Hao was made Vice Minister of Rites; former Zhengzhou defense vice commissioner Jiang Hongdao was made Minister of the Imperial Stud.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen Pei Hao—Secretariat drafter and acting examination director—became vice minister of rites, and former Zhengzhou defense vice commissioner Jiang Hongdao became minister of the imperial stud.

sentences.zh: 侍中郭崇韜奏：「應三銓注授官員等，內有自無出身入仕，買覓鬼名告敕；

translations.literal: Chief minister Guo Chongtao memorialized: "Among officers appointed through the three selection boards, some entered office without any pedigree and bought ghost-name patents;
translations.idiomatic: Guo Chongtao reported, "Among three-board appointees some had no pedigree and bought ghost-name patents;

sentences.zh: 今將骨肉文書，揩改姓名；

translations.literal: now they erase and alter names on kinship documents;
translations.idiomatic: now they alter kinship papers and names;

sentences.zh: 或曆任不足，妄稱失墜；

translations.literal: or their service records fall short yet they falsely claim loss;
translations.idiomatic: or claim lost records when tenure falls short;

sentences.zh: 或假人蔭緒，托形勢論屬，安排參選，所司隨例注官。

translations.literal: or borrow another's lineage and plead powerful connections to arrange candidacy, and the office routinely assigns posts.
translations.idiomatic: or borrow another's lineage and pull strings to enter selection and win routine appointment.

sentences.zh: 如有人陳告，特議超獎；

translations.literal: If someone denounces them, deliberate special reward;
translations.idiomatic: Informants should win special reward;

sentences.zh: 其所犯人，檢格處分；

translations.literal: the offenders are to be checked and punished;
translations.idiomatic: offenders checked and punished;

sentences.zh: 若同保人內有偽濫者，並當駁放。

translations.literal: if any guarantor within the group is fraudulent, all are to be rejected and dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: and if any guarantor is fraudulent, the whole group is rejected."

sentences.zh: 應有人身死之處，今後並須申報本州，於告身上批書身死月日分明付子孫。

translations.literal: Wherever a person has died, hereafter the native prefecture must be notified and the month and day of death clearly entered on the patent and handed to descendants.
translations.idiomatic: After any death the home prefecture must record month and day on the patent for heirs.

sentences.zh: 今後銓司公事，至春末並須了畢。

translations.literal: Hereafter selection-office business must all be finished by the end of spring.
translations.idiomatic: Selection business must finish by late spring.

sentences.zh: 」 從之。

translations.literal: 」 It was followed.
translations.idiomatic: 」The edict was approved.

sentences.zh: 銓綜之司，偽濫日久，及崇韜條奏之後，澄汰甚嚴，放棄者十有七八，眾情亦怨之。

translations.literal: The selection office had long been rife with fraud; after Chongtao's memorial the purge was very strict and seven or eight in ten were cast out—the crowd also resented it.
translations.idiomatic: The selection office had long been corrupt; after Chongtao's rules the purge was fierce and seven or eight in ten were cast aside, to public resentment.

sentences.zh: 己酉，司天台請禁私曆日，從之。

translations.literal: On jiyou, the Directorate of Astronomy asked to ban private calendars; it was followed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou Astronomy asked to ban private calendars; the court agreed.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，有司自契丹至者，言女真、回鶻、黃頭室韋合勢侵契丹。

translations.literal: On gengxu, an envoy returned from the Khitan saying the Jurchen, Uyghurs, and Yellow-head Shive had joined forces to invade the Khitan.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu a man back from the Khitan said Jurchen, Uyghur, and Yellow-head Shive had allied against them.

sentences.zh: 壬子，有司上言：「八月二十二日夜，熒惑犯星二度，星周分也，請依法禳之。

translations.literal: On renzi, the responsible offices submitted: "On the night of the twenty-second day of the eighth month Mars trespassed two degrees of the Star constellation—the Star is Zhou's asterism—we ask to perform exorcism by law.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi the rites offices said, "On the twenty-second night of the eighth month Mars crossed two degrees of Star—Zhou's asterism—so we ask lawful exorcism.

sentences.zh: 於京城四門懸東流水一罌，兼令都市嚴備盜火，止絕夜行。

translations.literal: At the capital's four gates hang one jar of east-flowing water; and order the markets strictly to guard against theft and fire and stop night travel.
translations.idiomatic: Hang east-flowing water at the four gates, tighten the markets against fire and theft, and forbid night travel."

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: 」It was followed.
translations.idiomatic: 」The court agreed.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，幸郭崇韜第，置酒作樂。

translations.literal: On jiayin, the Emperor visited Guo Chongtao's residence and set out wine and music.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin Cunxu visited Guo Chongtao's house for wine and music.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，以前振武節度使、安北都護馬存可依前檢校太尉、兼侍中，充寧遠軍節度、容管觀察使。

translations.literal: On yimao, former Zhenwu military commissioner and Protector-General of the Pacified North Ma Cun could remain acting Grand Commandant and concurrent chief minister, and was made Ningyuan army military commissioner and Rongguan observation commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao Ma Cun—former Zhenwu commissioner and Protector-General of the Pacified North—kept acting Grand Commandant and chief minister and became Ningyuan commissioner and Rongguan observer.

sentences.zh: 存，湖南馬殷之弟也。

translations.literal: Cun was the younger brother of Hunan's Ma Yin.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Cun was Ma Yin of Hunan's younger brother.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，黑水國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: On bingchen, the Heishui state sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen Heishui sent tribute envoys.

sentences.zh: 契丹寇幽州。

translations.literal: The Khitan raided Youzhou.
translations.idiomatic: The Khitan raided Youzhou.

sentences.zh: 戊午，宣宰臣於中書，磨勘吏部選人，謬濫者焚毀告敕。

translations.literal: On wuwu, the chancellors were ordered to the Secretariat to review Personnel candidates; the fraudulent had their patents burned.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu the chancellors were sent to the Secretariat to audit Personnel candidates and burn fraudulent patents.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊辰，帝畋於西北郊。

translations.literal: In the tenth month on wuchen, the Emperor hunted in the northwest suburb.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month on wuchen Cunxu hunted northwest of the city.

sentences.zh: 己巳，故安義節度使、贈太尉、隴西郡王李嗣昭贈太師。

translations.literal: On jisi, the late Anyi military commissioner, posthumously made Grand Commandant and Prince of Longxi Li Sizhao was posthumously made Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi the late Anyi commissioner Li Sizhao—posthumous Grand Commandant and Prince of Longxi—was raised to Grand Preceptor.

sentences.zh: 庚午，正衙命使冊淑妃韓氏、德妃伊氏，以宰臣豆盧革、韋說充冊使。

translations.literal: On gengwu, at the main court envoys were ordered to invest Pure Consort Han and Virtuous Consort Yi; chief ministers Dou Luge and Wei Shuo served as investiture envoys.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu at the main court envoys invested Pure Consort Han and Virtuous Consort Yi, with Dou Luge and Wei Shuo as investiture commissioners.

sentences.zh: 辛未，詔：「今後支郡公事，須申本道騰狀奏聞。

translations.literal: On xinwei, an edict: "Hereafter sub-prefecture business must be reported by memorial through the circuit.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei an edict said, "Hereafter sub-prefecture business must go up by circuit memorial.

sentences.zh: 租庸使各有征催祇牒，觀察使貴全理體。

translations.literal: Each rent-and-corvée commissioner has his own collection warrant, yet the observation commissioner prizes preserving overall order.
translations.idiomatic: Rent-and-corvée commissioners each issue collection warrants, yet observers prize keeping the circuit whole."

sentences.zh: 」契丹寇易、定北鄙。

translations.literal: 」The Khitan raided the northern border of Yi and Ding.
translations.idiomatic: The Khitan struck Yi and Ding's northern marches.

sentences.zh: 壬申，故大同軍防禦使李存璋贈太尉。

translations.literal: On renshen, the late Datong defense commissioner Li Cunzhang was posthumously made Grand Commandant.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen the late Datong defense commissioner Li Cunzhang was posthumously made Grand Commandant.

sentences.zh: 鄆州奏，清河泛溢，壞廬舍。

translations.literal: Yan prefecture memorialized that the Qing River overflowed and destroyed houses.
translations.idiomatic: Yan reported the Qing River flooded and wrecked houses.

sentences.zh: 癸未，畋於石橋。

translations.literal: On guiwei, the Emperor hunted at Shiqiao.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei Cunxu hunted at Shiqiao.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，河南尹張全義上言：「萬壽節日，請於嵩山開琉璃戒壇，度僧百人。

translations.literal: On jiaxu, Henan prefect Zhang Quanyi submitted: "On the Longevity Festival, I ask to open a glazed ordination platform on Mount Song and ordain a hundred monks.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu Henan prefect Zhang Quanyi asked to open a glazed ordination terrace on Mount Song at the Longevity Festival and ordain a hundred monks.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: 」It was followed.
translations.idiomatic: 」The throne approved.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，故守太師、尚書令、秦王李茂貞追封秦王，賜諡曰忠敬。

translations.literal: On yihai, the late Guardian Grand Preceptor, Director of the Secretariat, and Prince of Qin Li Maozhen was posthumously enfeoffed Prince of Qin and given the posthumous title Loyal and Respectful.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai Li Maozhen—late Guardian Grand Preceptor, Secretariat director, and Prince of Qin—was posthumously made Prince of Qin with the posthumous title Loyal and Respectful.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，皇后差使賜兗州節度使李紹欽湯藥。

translations.literal: On dingchou, the empress sent envoys to bestow medicinal broth on Yanzhou military commissioner Li Shaoqin.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou the empress sent envoys with medicinal broth to Li Shaoqin of Yanzhou.

sentences.zh: 時皇太后行誥命，皇后劉氏行教命，互遣使人宣達藩後，紊亂之弊，人不敢言。

translations.literal: At that time the empress dowager issued edicts and Empress Liu issued teaching orders; each sent envoys to announce them to the frontier—confusion from the practice, yet none dared speak.
translations.idiomatic: Then the empress dowager issued edicts and Empress Liu teaching orders, each sending envoys to the frontier—a muddle no one dared name.

sentences.zh: 己卯，汴、鄆二州奏，大水。

translations.literal: On jimao, Bian and Yan prefectures memorialized great floods.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao Bian and Yan reported great floods.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，以前太僕卿楊遘為大理卿。

translations.literal: On gengchen, former Minister of the Imperial Stud Yang Yi was made director of the Court of Judicial Review.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen Yang Yi, former minister of the imperial stud, became director of judicial review.

sentences.zh: 党項進白驢，奚王李紹威進駝馬。

translations.literal: The Tangut presented a white donkey; the Xi king Li Shaowei presented camels and horses.
translations.idiomatic: The Tangut sent a white donkey; Xi king Li Shaowei sent camels and horses.

sentences.zh: 幽州奏，契丹入寇，至近郊。

translations.literal: Youzhou memorialized that the Khitan had invaded as far as the near suburbs.
translations.idiomatic: Youzhou said the Khitan had reached the near suburbs.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，故天雄軍節度副使王緘贈司空。

translations.literal: On xinsi, the late Tianxiong army vice commissioner Wang Jian was posthumously made acting Sikong.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi the late Tianxiong vice commissioner Wang Jian was posthumously made acting Sikong.

sentences.zh: 壬午，以天下兵馬都元帥、尚父、守尚書令、吳越國王錢鏐可依前天下兵馬都元帥、尚父、守尚書令，封吳越國王。

translations.literal: On renwu, All-Army Marshal-in-Chief, Imperial Father, Guardian Director of the Secretariat, and King of Wuyue Qian Liu could remain All-Army Marshal-in-Chief, Imperial Father, and Guardian Director of the Secretariat, and was enfeoffed King of Wuyue.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu Qian Liu—marshal-in-chief, imperial father, guardian director—kept marshal-in-chief, imperial father, and director posts and was confirmed King of Wuyue.

sentences.zh: 癸未，幸小馬坊閱馬。

translations.literal: On guiwei, the Emperor visited the small horse paddock to review horses.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei Cunxu reviewed horses at the small paddock.

sentences.zh: 甲申，以兩浙兵馬留後、清海軍節度、嶺南東道觀察等使、守太尉、兼侍中、廣州刺史錢元尞為檢校太師、兼中書令，充兩浙節度觀察留後，餘如故；

translations.literal: On jiashen, Liangzhe army retention commissioner, Qinghai army military commissioner, Lingnan East Circuit observation commissioner, acting Grand Commandant, concurrent chief minister, and Guangzhou prefect Qian Yuanguan was made acting Grand Preceptor and concurrent Director of the Secretariat, and made Liangzhe circuit observation retention commissioner, the rest unchanged;
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen Qian Yuanguan of Liangzhe—Qinghai commissioner, Lingnan East observer, acting Grand Commandant, chief minister, Guangzhou prefect—became acting Grand Preceptor and Secretariat director and Liangzhe retention commissioner, keeping the rest;

sentences.zh: 以鎮東軍節度副大使、江南管內都招討使、建武軍節度、嶺南西道觀察等使、檢校太傅、守侍中、知蘇州中吳軍軍州事、行邕州刺史錢元尞為檢校太尉、兼中書令，餘如故。

translations.literal: Zhendong army vice ambassador, overall commander within Jiangnan, Jianwu army military commissioner, Lingnan West Circuit observation commissioner, acting Grand Tutor, acting chief minister, acting Suzhou Zhongwu army prefect Qian Yuanliao was made acting Grand Commandant and concurrent Director of the Secretariat, the rest unchanged.
translations.idiomatic: Qian Yuanliao of Zhendong—Jiangnan overall commander, Jianwu commissioner, Lingnan West observer, acting Grand Tutor, acting chief minister, acting Suzhou prefect—became acting Grand Commandant and Secretariat director, keeping the rest.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，天平軍監軍使柴重厚可特進、右領衛將軍同正，充鳳翔監軍使。

translations.literal: On xinmao, Tianping army supervisory commissioner Chai Chonghou could be specially advanced and made Right Imperial Guard general of the same rank, and made Fengxiang supervisory commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao Chai Chonghou of Tianping was specially advanced to Right Guard general of the same rank and made Fengxiang supervisory commissioner.

sentences.zh: 甲午，以宣武軍節度押牙李從溫、李從璋、李從榮、李從厚、李從璨並銀青光祿大夫、檢校右散騎常侍兼御史大夫，宣武軍節度押牙李從臻可檢校國子祭酒兼御史中丞。

translations.literal: On jiawu, Xuanyi army military commissioner's military adjutants Li Congwen, Li Congzhang, Li Congrong, Li Conghou, and Li Congcan were all made Silver Order of Glory Grand Masters, acting Right Regular Cavalier and concurrent Censor-in-chief; Xuanyi army military adjutant Li Congzhen could be made acting National University libationer and concurrent Vice Censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu Li Congwen, Li Congzhang, Li Congrong, Li Conghou, and Li Congcan—Xuanyi adjutants—became Silver Order grand masters and acting Right Regular Cavalier with censor-in-chief rank; Li Congzhen became acting National University libationer and vice censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 自從溫而下，皆李嗣源諸子也。

translations.literal: From Congwen down, all were sons of Li Siyuan.
translations.idiomatic: From Congwen down they were all Li Siyuan's sons.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙申，靈武奏，甘州回鶻可汗仁美卒，其弟狄銀權主國事。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month on bingchen, Lingwu memorialized that Gansu Uyghur khan Renmei had died and his younger brother Doyin provisionally held state affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month on bingchen Lingwu reported Gansu Uyghur khan Renmei dead and his brother Doyin ruling provisionally.

sentences.zh: 吐渾白都督族帳移於代州東南。

translations.literal: The Tuhun White-commander tribal encampments moved southeast of Daizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Tuhun White-commander tribes moved southeast of Daizhou.

sentences.zh: 己亥，幸六宅宴諸弟。

translations.literal: On jihai, the Emperor visited the Six Residences to feast his younger brothers.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai Cunxu feasted his younger brothers at the Six Residences.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，尚書左丞、判吏部尚書銓事崔沂貶麟州司馬，吏部侍郎崔貽孫貶朔州司馬，給事中鄭韜光貶寧州司馬，吏部員外盧損貶府州司戶。

translations.literal: On renyin, Left Secretariat Director and acting Personnel Minister Cui Yi was demoted to Linzhou aide; Vice Minister of Personnel Cui Yisun was demoted to Shuozhou aide; Attendant-in-ordinary Zheng Taoguang was demoted to Ningzhou aide; Personnel Vice Director Lu Sun was demoted to Fuzhou registrar.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Cui Yi—Left Secretariat director and acting Personnel minister—was demoted to Linzhou aide; Cui Yisun to Shuozhou aide; Zheng Taoguang to Ningzhou aide; Lu Sun to Fuzhou registrar.

sentences.zh: 時有選人吳延皓取亡叔告身故舊名求仕，事發，延皓付河南府處死，崔沂已下貶官。

translations.literal: At that time the candidate Wu Yanhao took his dead uncle's patent and old name to seek office; when the matter broke out Yanhao was handed to Henan prefecture for execution, and Cui Yi and the rest were demoted.
translations.idiomatic: Then candidate Wu Yanhao used his dead uncle's patent and old name to seek office; exposed, Yanhao was executed by Henan prefecture and Cui Yi and the rest were demoted.

sentences.zh: 宰相豆盧革、趙光裔、韋說詣閣門待罪，詔釋之。

translations.literal: Chancellors Dou Luge, Zhao Guangyi, and Wei Shuo went to the Gate of Receiving Mandates to await punishment; an edict released them.
translations.idiomatic: Chancellors Dou Luge, Zhao Guangyi, and Wei Shuo waited at the Gate of Receiving Mandates for punishment; an edict pardoned them.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，帝畋於伊闕，侍衛金槍馬萬餘騎從，帝一發中大鹿。

translations.literal: On guimao, the Emperor hunted at Yique; more than ten thousand golden-lance cavalry of the guard followed, and with one shot he struck a great stag.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao Cunxu hunted at Yique with more than ten thousand golden-lance guards and dropped a great stag at one shot.

sentences.zh: 是日，命從官拜梁祖之陵，物議非之。

translations.literal: That day he ordered his followers to bow at the Liang Founder's tomb; public opinion condemned it.
translations.idiomatic: That day he made followers bow at the Liang Founder's tomb—to public censure.

sentences.zh: 其夕，宿於張全義之別墅。

translations.literal: That evening he lodged at Zhang Quanyi's villa.
translations.idiomatic: That night he stayed at Zhang Quanyi's villa.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，宿伊闕縣。

translations.literal: On jiachen, he lodged at Yique county.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen he lodged at Yique county.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，宿椹澗。

translations.literal: On yisi, he lodged at Zhenjian.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi he lodged at Zhenjian.

sentences.zh: 時騎士圍山，會夜，顛墜崖穀，死傷甚眾。

translations.literal: At that time the horsemen ringed the mountain; when night came many tumbled into ravines, and dead and wounded were very numerous.
translations.idiomatic: Horsemen had ringed the mountain; at night many fell into ravines, with heavy dead and wounded.

sentences.zh: 丙午，復命衛兵分獵，殺獲萬計。

translations.literal: On bingwu, he again ordered guard troops to hunt separately; kills and captures numbered in the tens of thousands.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu he again split the guard for a hunt that took tens of thousands.

sentences.zh: 是夜，方歸京城，六街火炬如晝。

translations.literal: That night, just as he returned to the capital, torches on the six streets blazed like day.
translations.idiomatic: That night, returning to the capital, torches on the six streets blazed like noon.

sentences.zh: 丁未，賜群臣鹿肉有差。

translations.literal: On dingwei, deer meat was bestowed on the ministers in graded shares.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei ministers received graded shares of venison.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，製改節將一十一人功臣號。

translations.literal: On gengxu, an edict revised the merit titles of eleven military commissioners.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu an edict revised merit titles for eleven commissioners.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，以兵部侍郎李德休為吏部侍郎。

translations.literal: On xinhai, Vice Minister of War Li Detiu was made Vice Minister of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai Li Detiu of War became Personnel vice minister.

sentences.zh: 壬子，日南至，百官拜表稱賀。

translations.literal: On renzi, the winter solstice; the hundred officials submitted congratulatory memorials.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, the winter solstice, officials submitted congratulatory memorials.

sentences.zh: 以昭儀侯氏為汧國夫人，昭容夏氏為虢國夫人，昭媛白氏為沛國夫人，出使美宣鄧氏為魏國夫人，禦正楚真張氏為涼國夫人，司簿德美周氏為宋國夫人，侍真吳氏為渤海郡夫人，其餘並封郡夫人。

translations.literal: Shining Lady Hou was made Lady of Qian, Shining Beauty Xia was made Lady of Guo, Shining Companion Bai was made Lady of Pei, Palace Envoy of Fine Announcement Deng was made Lady of Wei, Imperial Rectifier Chuzhen Zhang was made Lady of Liang, Registrar of Virtuous Beauty Zhou was made Lady of Song, Attendant of Truth Wu was made Lady of Bohai, and the rest were all made ladies of commanderies.
translations.idiomatic: Shining Lady Hou became Lady of Qian, Shining Beauty Xia Lady of Guo, Shining Companion Bai Lady of Pei, envoy of fine announcement Deng Lady of Wei, rectifier Chuzhen Zhang Lady of Liang, registrar of virtuous beauty Zhou Lady of Song, attendant of truth Wu Lady of Bohai, and the rest county ladies.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，河中節度使、守太師、兼尚書令、西平王李繼麟可依前守太師、兼尚書令、河中護國軍節度使、西平王，仍賜鐵券。

translations.literal: On dingsi, Hezhong military commissioner, Guardian Grand Preceptor, concurrent Director of the Secretariat, and Prince of Xiping Li Jilin could remain Guardian Grand Preceptor and concurrent Director of the Secretariat, Hezhong Huguo army military commissioner, and Prince of Xiping, and was also granted an iron tally.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi Li Jilin of Hezhong—Guardian Grand Preceptor, chancellor, Prince of Xiping—kept those posts as Huguo commissioner and also received an iron tally.

sentences.zh: 戊午，幸李嗣源、李紹榮之第，縱酒作樂。

translations.literal: On wuwu, the Emperor visited the residences of Li Siyuan and Li Shaorong and drank freely with music.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu Cunxu visited Li Siyuan and Li Shaorong and drank with music.

sentences.zh: 是日，鎮州地震；

translations.literal: That day, Zhen prefecture had an earthquake;
translations.idiomatic: That day Zhen had an earthquake;

sentences.zh: 契丹寇蔚州。

translations.literal: the Khitan raided Wei prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: and the Khitan raided Wei.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊辰，幸西苑校獵。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month on wuchen, the Emperor visited the Western Park to review the hunt.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month on wuchen Cunxu reviewed the hunt at the Western Park.

sentences.zh: 己巳，詔汴州節度使李嗣源歸鎮。

translations.literal: On jisi, an edict ordered Bianzhou military commissioner Li Siyuan to return to his post.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi an edict sent Bianzhou commissioner Li Siyuan back to his post.

translations.literal: 〈Bracket note
translations.idiomatic: 〈Note

sentences.zh: （《通鑒》作：己巳，命宣武軍節度使李嗣源將宿衛兵三萬七千人赴汴州，遂如幽州禦契丹。）〉

translations.literal: (The 《Zizhi Tongjian》 reads: On jisi, Xuanyi army military commissioner Li Siyuan was ordered to lead thirty-seven thousand palace guards to Bianzhou and then proceed to Youzhou to repel the Khitan.)〉
translations.idiomatic: (The 《Zizhi Tongjian》 says on jisi Li Siyuan of Xuanyi was ordered to march thirty-seven thousand palace guards to Bian and then on to Youzhou against the Khitan.)〉

sentences.zh: 庚午，帝與皇后劉氏幸張全義第，酒酣，帝命皇后拜全義為養父，全義惶恐致謝，復出珍貨貢獻。

translations.literal: On gengwu, the Emperor and Empress Liu visited Zhang Quanyi's residence; when the wine was deep the Emperor ordered the empress to bow to Quanyi as adoptive father; Quanyi in fear and trembling thanked him and again presented precious goods in tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu Cunxu and Empress Liu visited Zhang Quanyi; deep in wine Cunxu made the empress bow to Quanyi as adoptive father; Quanyi trembled, thanked him, and again sent treasures.

sentences.zh: 翌日，皇后傳制，命學士草謝全義書，學士趙鳳密疏，陳國後無拜人臣為父之禮，帝雖嘉之，竟不能已其事。

translations.literal: The next day the empress transmitted an order commanding the academicians to draft a letter thanking Quanyi; academician Zhao Feng submitted a secret memorial stating that after becoming ruler there was no rite of bowing to a subject as father; though the Emperor praised it, in the end he could not stop the affair.
translations.idiomatic: Next day the empress ordered academicians to draft thanks to Quanyi; Zhao Feng secretly argued that a ruler does not bow to a subject as father—Cunxu praised him yet could not stop it.

sentences.zh: 壬申，以教坊使王承顏為興州刺史。

translations.literal: On renshen, music-bureau commissioner Wang Chengyan was made Xingzhou prefect.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen music-bureau commissioner Wang Chengyan became Xing prefect.

sentences.zh: 丙申，詔取來年正月七日幸魏州。

translations.literal: On bingchen, an edict set the first day of the first month of next year for a visit to Weizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen an edict set the seventh of next year's first month for a visit to Wei.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，畋於近郊，至夕還宮。

translations.literal: On gengchen, the Emperor hunted in the near suburbs and returned to the palace at evening.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen Cunxu hunted near the city and returned at dusk.

sentences.zh: 壬午，契丹寇嵐州。

translations.literal: On renwu, the Khitan raided Lan prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu the Khitan raided Lan.

sentences.zh: 党項遣使貢方物。

translations.literal: The Tangut sent envoys with local products.
translations.idiomatic: The Tangut sent tribute envoys.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，幸龍門佛寺祈雪。

translations.literal: On yiyou, the Emperor visited Longmen Buddhist temple to pray for snow.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou Cunxu visited Longmen temple to pray for snow.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，以徐州節度使李紹真為北面行營副招討使。

translations.literal: On bingxu, Xuzhou military commissioner Li Shaozhen was made northern campaign army vice overall commander.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Li Shaozhen of Xuzhou became northern campaign vice overall commander.

sentences.zh: 戊子，李嗣源奏，部署大軍自宣武軍北征。

translations.literal: On wuzi, Li Siyuan memorialized that he had deployed the great army for a northern campaign from Xuanyi.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi Li Siyuan reported deploying the main army north from Xuanyi.

sentences.zh: 淮南楊溥遣使貢獻。

translations.literal: Yang Pu of Huainan sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Pu of Huainan sent tribute envoys.

sentences.zh: 己丑，幸龍門。

translations.literal: On jichou, the Emperor visited Longmen.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou Cunxu visited Longmen.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，詔河南尹張全義為洛京留守，判在京諸軍事。

translations.literal: On gengyin, an edict made Henan Intendant Zhang Quanyi Luoyang capital residence-regent and placed him in charge of all military affairs in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin Zhang Quanyi as Henan intendant was made Luoyang residence-regent with command of capital forces.

sentences.zh: 是日，日傍有背氣，凡十二。

translations.literal: That day twelve halos appeared beside the sun.
translations.idiomatic: That day twelve solar halos were seen.

sentences.zh: 同光三年春正月甲午朔，帝御明堂殿受朝賀，仗衛如式。

translations.literal: Tongguang year 3, spring, first month, jiawu new moon: the Emperor attended Bright Hall for new-year congratulations; guards and escort followed the prescribed form.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of Tongguang 3, on the jiawu new moon, the Emperor held new-year court in Bright Hall with full guard.

sentences.zh: 丙申，詔以昭宗、少帝山陵未備，宜令有司別選園陵改葬，尋以年饑財匱而止。

translations.literal: On bingshen, an edict: because Emperor Zhaozong and the Young Emperor's mausoleums were not complete, relevant offices should choose new burial mounds for reinterment; soon the plan was halted for famine and depleted funds.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen an edict ordered new tombs for Zhaozong and the Young Emperor; famine and empty coffers soon stopped the work.

sentences.zh: 契丹寇幽州。

translations.literal: The Khitan raided Youzhou.
translations.idiomatic: The Khitan struck Youzhou.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，詔：「起今後特恩授官及侍衛諸軍將校、內諸司等官，其告身官給，舊例朱膠錢、台省禮錢並停，其餘合征台省禮錢，比舊數五分中許征一分，特恩者不征。

translations.literal: On wuxu, an edict: "From now on, for specially favored appointments and for guard-army officers and inner-palace offices, the commission documents and salary grants formerly charged cinnabar-glue fees and secretariat courtesy fees are all abolished; for other cases where secretariat courtesy fees are due, only one part in five of the old amount may be collected, and none from special favors.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu an edict said, "Henceforth special appointments and guard or inner-palace officers lose cinnabar-glue and secretariat courtesy fees; where courtesy fees remain, collect only one-fifth of the old rate, and none on special favors.

sentences.zh: 兵、吏部兩司逐月各支錢四十貫文，充吏人食直。

translations.literal: The War and Personnel ministries are each to pay forty strings a month for clerks' board.
translations.idiomatic: War and Personnel are each to pay forty strings monthly for clerks' rations.

sentences.zh: 少府監鑄錢造印文，今後不得征納銅炭價直，其料物官給。

translations.literal: The Mint Directorate casting coin and seal inscriptions may no longer collect copper and charcoal charges; materials are to be supplied by the state.
translations.idiomatic: The mint may no longer charge for copper and charcoal; the state supplies materials.

sentences.zh: 」庚子，車駕發京師幸鄴。

translations.literal: 」On gengzi the imperial carriage left the capital for Ye.
translations.idiomatic: 」On gengzi the court set out for Ye.

sentences.zh: 以前許州節度使李紹衝為太子少保；

translations.literal: Former Xuzhou military commissioner Li Shaochong was made Junior Tutor of the Heir Apparent;
translations.idiomatic: Li Shaochong, former Xuzhou commissioner, became Junior Tutor of the Heir Apparent;

sentences.zh: 以前邠州節度使韓恭為右金吾大將軍，充兩街使；

translations.literal: former Binzhou military commissioner Han Gong was made Right Golden Guard senior general and charged as commissioner of the two wards;
translations.idiomatic: Han Gong of Binzhou became Right Golden Guard senior general and two-ward commissioner;

sentences.zh: 以前安州節度使朱漢賓為左龍武統軍。

translations.literal: former Anzhou military commissioner Zhu Hanbin was made Left Dragon Martial commander.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Hanbin of Anzhou became Left Dragon Martial commander.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，車駕至鄴。

translations.literal: On gengxu the imperial carriage reached Ye.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu the court arrived at Ye.

sentences.zh: 命青州節度使符習修酸棗河堤。

translations.literal: Qingzhou military commissioner Fu Xi was ordered to repair the Suanzao River dike.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Xi of Qing was ordered to repair the Suanzao River dike.

sentences.zh: 先是，梁末帝決河隄，引水東注至鄆、濮，以限我軍，至是方修之。

translations.literal: Earlier, the Last Emperor of Liang had breached the dike and diverted the river east toward Yan and Pu to hem in our army; only now was it being repaired.
translations.idiomatic: Liang's last emperor had cut the dike to flood Yan and Pu against our armies; repair began only now.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，幽州上言，節度使李存賢卒。

translations.literal: On bingchen Youzhou reported that military commissioner Li Cunxian had died.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen Youzhou reported the death of commissioner Li Cunxian.

sentences.zh: 二月甲子朔，詔：「興唐府管內有百姓隨絲鹽錢，每兩與減五十文。

translations.literal: Second month, jiazi new moon, an edict: "Within Xingtang prefecture, where the people pay silk-salt money, reduce fifty cash per liang.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi new moon in the second month an edict said, "In Xingtang circuit reduce silk-salt money by fifty cash per liang.

sentences.zh: 逐年所亻表蠶鹽，每鬥與減五十文。

translations.literal: For annual delivered cocoon-salt, reduce fifty cash per dou.
translations.idiomatic: For annual cocoon-salt deliveries, reduce fifty cash per dou.

sentences.zh: 小菉豆稅，每畝與減放三升。

translations.literal: For the small mung-bean tax, remit three sheng per mu.
translations.idiomatic: Remit three sheng of the small mung-bean tax per mu.

sentences.zh: 都城內所征稅絲，永與除放。

translations.literal: The silk tax levied within the capital is abolished forever.
translations.idiomatic: The capital silk tax is abolished forever.

sentences.zh: 」丙寅，定州節度使王都來朝。

translations.literal: 」On bingyin, Dingzhou military commissioner Wang Du came to court.
translations.idiomatic: 」On bingyin Wang Du of Ding came to court.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，畋於近郊。

translations.literal: On dingmao he hunted in the near suburbs.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao he hunted near the city.

sentences.zh: 己巳，召從臣擊球於鞠場。

translations.literal: On jisi he summoned attending ministers to play cuju on the ball ground.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi he summoned ministers for cuju on the ball ground.

sentences.zh: 辛未，許州上言：「襄城、葉縣準敕割隸汝州，其扶溝等縣請卻隸當州。

translations.literal: On xinwei Xuzhou reported: "Xiangcheng and Ye counties were by edict transferred to Ru prefecture; we ask that Fugou and other counties be returned to this prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei Xuzhou asked that Fugou and other counties, after Xiangcheng and Ye went to Ru by edict, return to Xuzhou.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: 」It was followed.
translations.idiomatic: 」The request was granted.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，以滄州節度使李紹斌為幽州節度使，依前檢校太保；

translations.literal: On jiaxu, Cangzhou military commissioner Li Shaobin was made Youzhou military commissioner, still acting Grand Guardian;
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu Li Shaobin of Cang became Youzhou commissioner, still acting Grand Guardian;

sentences.zh: 以大同軍留後安元信為滄州節度使。

translations.literal: Datong army acting commissioner An Yuanxin was made Cangzhou military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: An Yuanxin, Datong acting commissioner, took Cang.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，幸王莽河射雁。

translations.literal: On yihai he visited Wangmang River to shoot wild geese.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai he shot geese at Wangmang River.

sentences.zh: 丙子，李嗣源奏，涿州東南殺敗契丹，生擒首領三十人。

translations.literal: On bingzi Li Siyuan memorialized that southeast of Zhuo prefecture the Khitan had been defeated and thirty leaders taken alive.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi Li Siyuan reported defeating the Khitan southeast of Zhuo and capturing thirty leaders.

sentences.zh: 符習奏，修堤役夫遇雪寒逃散。

translations.literal: Fu Xi memorialized that dike laborers had scattered in snow and cold.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Xi reported dike workers fleeing the snow and cold.

sentences.zh: 樞密使郭崇韜上表辭兼鎮。

translations.literal: Chief Palace Secretary Guo Chongtao submitted a memorial declining the concurrent prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Chongtao asked to give up his concurrent command.

sentences.zh: 時帝命李紹斌鎮幽州，以其時望未重，欲以李嗣源為鎮帥，且為紹斌聲援，移郭崇韜兼領汴州。

translations.literal: The Emperor had ordered Li Shaobin to hold Youzhou; because his standing was not yet weighty, he wished Li Siyuan as military commander to support Shaobin and shifted Guo Chongtao to hold Bianzhou concurrently.
translations.idiomatic: Shaobin's standing at Youzhou was still light, so the throne wanted Li Siyuan as backing and moved Guo Chongtao to concurrent Bian.

sentences.zh: 召崇韜議之，崇韜奏以為當，因懇辭兼領。

translations.literal: Chongtao was summoned to discuss it; he said the plan was right and earnestly declined the concurrent post.
translations.idiomatic: Chongtao was summoned, approved the plan, and begged off the concurrent post.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，以宣武軍節度使李嗣源為鎮州節度使。

translations.literal: On gengchen, Xuanyi army military commissioner Li Siyuan was made Zhenzhou military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen Li Siyuan of Xuanyi became Zhen commissioner.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，以皇子繼潼、繼嵩、繼蟾、繼嶢並檢校司徒，皆衝幼，未出閣。

translations.literal: On xinsi the princes Jitong, Jisong, Jichan, and Jiyao were all made acting Secretariat Directors; all were infants and had not left the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi the infant princes Jitong, Jisong, Jichan, and Jiyao were made acting Secretariat Directors, none yet out of the palace.

sentences.zh: 突厥、渤海國皆遣使貢方物。

translations.literal: Tujue and Parhae both sent envoys with local products.
translations.idiomatic: Tujue and Parhae both sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 帝幸近郊射雁。

translations.literal: The Emperor visited the near suburbs to shoot wild geese.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor hunted geese in the suburbs.

sentences.zh: 甲申，以樞密使郭崇韜為依前守侍中、監修國史、兼樞密使，加食邑實封。

translations.literal: On jiashen, Chief Palace Secretary Guo Chongtao remained acting Palace Attendant, director of compiling the national history, and concurrent chief secretary, with added fief income and enfeoffment.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen Guo Chongtao kept Palace Attendant, national-history director, and chief secretary, with added fief and seal.

sentences.zh: 廣南劉岩遣使奉書於帝，稱「大漢國王致書上大唐皇帝」。

translations.literal: Liu Yan of Guangnan sent envoys with a letter to the Emperor reading, "The King of Great Han writes to the Emperor of Great Tang."
translations.idiomatic: Liu Yan of the south sent a letter opening, "The King of Great Han to the Emperor of Great Tang."

sentences.zh: 乙酉，帝射鴨於郭泊。

translations.literal: On yiyou the Emperor shot ducks at Guo Marsh.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou he shot ducks at Guo Marsh.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，定州節度使、檢校太尉、兼侍中王都進封開國公，加食邑實封。

translations.literal: On bingxu, Dingzhou military commissioner, acting Grand Commandant, and concurrent Palace Attendant Wang Du was advanced to Duke Who Opens the State, with added fief income and enfeoffment.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Wang Du of Ding—acting Grand Commandant and Palace Attendant—was made Duke Who Opens the State with added fief.

sentences.zh: 戊子，幸近郊射雁。

translations.literal: On wuzi he visited the near suburbs to shoot wild geese.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi he again hunted geese in the suburbs.

sentences.zh: 工部尚書崔柅卒，贈右僕射。

translations.literal: Minister of Works Cui Ni died and was posthumously made Right Vice Director.
translations.idiomatic: Cui Ni of Works died and was posthumously made Right Vice Director.

sentences.zh: 三月癸巳朔，賜扈從諸軍將士優給，自二十千至一千。

translations.literal: Third month, guisi new moon: the escort armies were given extra grants from twenty thousand down to one thousand.
translations.idiomatic: On the guisi new moon escort troops received bonuses from twenty thousand down to one thousand.

sentences.zh: 甲午，振武軍節度使、洛京內外蕃漢馬步使朱守殷奏，昨修月陂堤，至德宮南獲玉璽一紐，獻之。

translations.literal: On jiawu, Zhenwu military commissioner and Luoyang inner-and-outer Han-and-barbarian horse-and-foot commissioner Zhu Shouyin memorialized that while repairing the Moon Mound dike south of Zhide Palace he had found one jade seal and presented it.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu Zhu Shouyin of Zhenwu reported finding a jade seal while repairing the Moon Mound dike south of Zhide Palace and presented it.

sentences.zh: 詔示百官，驗其文，曰「皇帝行寶」 四字，方圓八寸，厚二寸，背紐交龍，光瑩精妙。

translations.literal: An edict showed it to the hundred officials; examining the inscription, it bore the four characters "Emperor's traveling treasure," eight cun square and two cun thick, with a crossed-dragon knob on the back, lustrous and exquisite.
translations.idiomatic: The court displayed it; the inscription read "Emperor's traveling treasure," eight by two cun, crossed-dragon knob, bright and fine.

sentences.zh: 守殷又於役所得古文錢四百六十六，內二十六文曰「得一元寶」，四百四十曰「順天元寶」，上之。

translations.literal: Shouyin also found four hundred sixty-six antique coins in the labor: twenty-six reading "De yi yuan bao" and four hundred forty reading "Shun tian yuan bao," and presented them.
translations.idiomatic: Shouyin also turned up 466 antique coins—26 "De yi yuan bao" and 440 "Shun tian yuan bao."

translations.literal: 〈Bracket note
translations.idiomatic: 〈Note

sentences.zh: （龐元英《文昌雜錄》云：同光三年，洛京積善坊得古文錢，曰「得一元寶」，「順天元寶」，史不載何代鑄錢。

translations.literal: (Pang Yuanying's 《Miscellany from Wenchang》 says: In Tongguang 3, Jishan ward in Luoyang yielded antique coins reading "De yi yuan bao" and "Shun tian yuan bao"; the history does not record which age cast them.
translations.idiomatic: (Pang Yuanying's 《Wenchang Miscellany》 says Tongguang 3 coins from Jishan ward read "De yi yuan bao" and "Shun tian yuan bao," with no dynasty named in the annals.

sentences.zh: 近見錢氏《錢譜》云：史思明再陷洛陽，鑄「得一錢」，賊黨以為「得一」非佳號，乃改「順天」。

translations.literal: Recently the Qian clan's 《Coin Canon》 says: when Shi Siming again took Luoyang he cast "De yi" coin; the rebels thought "de yi" an ill omen and changed it to "Shun tian."
translations.idiomatic: The Qian 《Coin Canon》 says Shi Siming cast "De yi" at Luoyang, then renamed it "Shun tian" as a bad omen.

sentences.zh: 蓋史思明所鑄錢也。）〉

translations.literal: These were coins cast by Shi Siming.)〉
translations.idiomatic: They were Shi Siming's coinage.)〉

sentences.zh: 丙子，寒食節，帝與皇后出近郊，遙饗代州親廟。

translations.literal: On bingzi, Cold Food Festival, the Emperor and Empress went to the near suburbs and made a distant offering to the ancestral temple at Dai prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, Cold Food, the Emperor and Empress went to the suburbs and offered remotely to the Dai ancestral temple.

sentences.zh: 庚子，詔取三月十七日車駕歸洛京。

translations.literal: On gengzi an edict fixed the seventeenth day of the third month for the imperial carriage to return to Luoyang.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi an edict set the seventeenth of the third month for return to Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，符習奏，修河堤畢功。

translations.literal: On renyin Fu Xi memorialized that dike repair was complete.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Fu Xi reported the dike finished.

sentences.zh: 戊申，帝召郭崇韜謂曰：「朕思在德勝寨時，霍彥威、段凝皆予之敵。

translations.literal: On wushen the Emperor summoned Guo Chongtao and said: "I think of our days at Desheng stockade, when Huo Yanwei and Duan Ning were both my foes.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen the Emperor told Guo Chongtao, "I remember Desheng stockade, when Huo Yanwei and Duan Ning were my enemies.

sentences.zh: 終日格鬥，戰聲相聞，安知二年之間，在吾廡下。

translations.literal: All day we grappled and battle cries rang unceasing—who could know that within two years they would stand beneath my eaves?
translations.idiomatic: We fought all day within earshot—who imagined that in two years they would serve under my roof?

sentences.zh: 吾無少康、光武之才，一旦重興基構者，良由二三勳德同心輔翼故也。

translations.literal: I lack the talent of Shaokang or Guangwu; that the foundation could suddenly rise again was truly because two or three meritorious ministers aided in one heart.
translations.idiomatic: I am no Shaokang or Guangwu; the realm rose again only because a few ministers stood together.

sentences.zh: 朕有時夢寢，如在戚城，思念曩時挑戰鏖兵，勞則勞矣，然而揚旌伐鼓，差慰人心，殘壘荒溝，依然在目。

translations.literal: Sometimes waking or sleeping I seem to be at Qi city, recalling the old challenges and fierce battles—hard labor, yet raising banners and beating drums still somewhat comforted the heart; ruined ramparts and desolate ditches still lie before the eyes.
translations.idiomatic: In dream I am back at Qi, remembering the old battles—grueling, yet drums and banners still heartened men; ruined walls and empty trenches still stand in view.

sentences.zh: 予欲按德勝故寨，與卿再陳舊事。

translations.literal: I wish to visit the old Desheng stockade and recount the past with you."
translations.idiomatic: I want to walk the old Desheng camp and tell the tale again with you."

sentences.zh: 」崇韜曰：「此去澶州不遠，陛下再觀戰地，益知王業之艱難，豈不韙哉！

translations.literal: Chongtao said: "It is not far to Cao prefecture; if Your Majesty views the battlefield again you will better know how hard kingship is—is that not excellent?"
translations.idiomatic: Chongtao said, "Cao is near; seeing the field again would teach how hard the throne is won—is that not wise?"

sentences.zh: 」己酉，車駕發鄴宮。

translations.literal: 」On jiyou the imperial carriage left the Ye palace.
translations.idiomatic: 」On jiyou the court left Ye.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，至德勝城。

translations.literal: On xinhai it reached Desheng city.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai it reached Desheng.
