sentences.zh: 登城四望，指戰陣之處以諭宰臣。

translations.literal: He climbed the wall and looked about on four sides, pointing out where the battle lines had stood to instruct the chief ministers.
translations.idiomatic: He climbed the wall, looked about, and pointed out the old battle lines to his ministers.

sentences.zh: 渡河南觀廢柵舊址，至楊村寨，沿河至戚城，置酒作樂而罷。

translations.literal: Crossing the river south he viewed the ruined stockade sites, reached Yang village stockade, followed the river to Qi city, set out wine and music, then stopped.
translations.idiomatic: South of the river he traced ruined camps to Yang village and Qi, feasted, and turned back.

sentences.zh: 壬子，淮南楊溥遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: On renzi Yang Pu of Huainan sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi Yang Pu of Huainan sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 東京副留守張憲奏，諸營家口一千二百人逃亡，以艱食故也。

translations.literal: Eastern Capital deputy residence-regent Zhang Xian memorialized that twelve hundred dependents of the camps had fled for lack of food.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Xian of the Eastern Capital reported 1,200 camp dependents fleeing for hunger.

sentences.zh: 時宮苑使王允平、伶人景進為帝廣采宮人，不擇良家委巷，殆千餘人，車駕不給，載以牛車，累累於路焉。

translations.literal: At that time Palace Parks Commissioner Wang Yunping and actor Jing Jin broadly gathered palace women for the Emperor without choosing respectable households or lanes—nearly a thousand persons; the imperial train could not supply them, and they were loaded on ox carts, strung out along the road.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Yunping and the actor Jing Jin swept up nearly a thousand palace women from every alley; ox carts lined the road for lack of transport.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，車駕至自鄴。

translations.literal: On gengchen the imperial carriage returned from Ye.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen the court returned from Ye.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，詔本朝以雍州為西京，洛州為東都，并州為北都。

translations.literal: On xinyou an edict: "This dynasty takes Yong prefecture as Western Capital, Luo as Eastern Capital, and Bing as Northern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou an edict said, "Yong is Western Capital, Luo Eastern Capital, and Bing Northern Capital.

sentences.zh: 近以魏州為東京，宜依舊以洛京為東都，魏州改為鄴都，與北都並為次府。

translations.literal: Recently Weizhou was made Eastern Capital; it is proper to restore Luoyang as Eastern Capital, change Weizhou to Ye Capital, and rank it with the Northern Capital as a secondary metropolis."
translations.idiomatic: Weizhou had lately been Eastern Capital; Luoyang should again be Eastern Capital, Weizhou renamed Ye Capital, and Ye ranked with Bing as a secondary seat."

sentences.zh: 夏四月癸亥朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, guihai new moon: there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On the guihai new moon in the fourth month the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 以租庸副使孔循權知汴州軍州事。

translations.literal: Rent-and-corvée vice commissioner Kong Xun was made acting Bianzhou military and civil commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Kong Xun, rent-and-corvée vice commissioner, took acting Bian.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，淮南楊溥遣使貢方物。

translations.literal: On bingyin Yang Pu of Huainan sent envoys with local products.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin Yang Pu sent tribute goods.

sentences.zh: 壬申，幸甘泉亭。

translations.literal: On renshen he visited Sweet Spring Pavilion.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen he visited Sweet Spring Pavilion.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，詔翰林學士承旨盧質覆試新及第進士。

translations.literal: On guiyou an edict ordered Hanlin Academician Expositor Lu Zhi to re-examine the newly passed metropolitan graduates.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou Lu Zhi of Hanlin was ordered to re-test the new jinshi.

translations.literal: 〈Bracket note
translations.idiomatic: 〈Note

sentences.zh: （《五代會要》：時以新及第進士符蒙正等尚幹浮議，故命盧質覆試。）〉

translations.literal: (The 《Institutes of the Five Dynasties》: because the new graduates including Fu Mengzheng still drew empty talk, Lu Zhi was ordered to re-examine them.)〉
translations.idiomatic: (The 《Five Dynasties Institutes》 says Fu Mengzheng and others still seemed shallow, so Lu Zhi re-tested them.)〉

sentences.zh: 租庸使奏：「時雨久愆，請下諸道州府，依法祈禱。

translations.literal: The rent-and-corvée commissioner memorialized: "Rain has long been delayed; we ask that all circuits and prefectures pray by law.
translations.idiomatic: The rent commissioner asked that every circuit and prefecture pray for rain by law.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: 」It was followed.
translations.idiomatic: 」The request was granted.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，帝與皇后幸郭崇韜第，又幸左龍武統軍朱漢賓之第。

translations.literal: On yihai the Emperor and Empress visited Guo Chongtao's residence, then visited Left Dragon Martial commander Zhu Hanbin's residence.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai the Emperor and Empress visited Guo Chongtao, then Zhu Hanbin.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，以耀州為團練州，其順義軍額宜停。

translations.literal: On wuyin Yao prefecture was made a training prefecture and the Shunyi army title was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin Yao became a training prefecture and the Shunyi army title ended.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，帝侍皇太后幸會節園，遂幸李紹榮之第。

translations.literal: On gengchen the Emperor attended the Empress Dowager at Festival Garden, then visited Li Shaorong's residence.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen he escorted the Empress Dowager to Festival Garden, then visited Li Shaorong.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，以旱甚，詔河南府徙市，造五方龍，集巫禱祭。

translations.literal: On xinsi, because drought was severe, an edict ordered Henan prefecture to move the market, make five-direction dragons, and gather shamans for prayer.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, in severe drought, Henan was told to shift the market, fashion five dragons, and gather shamans.

sentences.zh: 癸未，以兗州節度使李紹欽為鄧州節度使。

translations.literal: On guiwei Yanzhou military commissioner Li Shaoqin was made Dengzhou military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei Li Shaoqin of Yan became Deng commissioner.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，以鎮州節度使李嗣源兼北面水陸轉運使，以徐州節度使李紹真為副。

translations.literal: On dinghai Zhenzhou military commissioner Li Siyuan was made concurrent northern land-and-water transport commissioner, with Xuzhou military commissioner Li Shaozhen as deputy.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai Li Siyuan of Zhen took northern transport with Li Shaozhen of Xuzhou as deputy.

sentences.zh: 禮部貢院新及第進士四人，其王澈改為第一，桑維翰第二，符蒙正第三，成僚第四。

translations.literal: The Ministry of Rites examination yard had four new graduates: Wang Che was changed to first place, Sang Weihan second, Fu Mengzheng third, and Cheng Liao fourth.
translations.idiomatic: Four new jinshi were re-ranked: Wang Che first, Sang Weihan second, Fu Mengzheng third, Cheng Liao fourth.

sentences.zh: 禮部侍郎裴皞既無黜落，特議寬容。

translations.literal: Vice Minister of Rites Pei Hao had dismissed none and was specially treated with leniency.
translations.idiomatic: Pei Hao of Rites had failed none and was treated leniently.

sentences.zh: 今後新及第人，候過堂日委中書門下精加詳覆。

translations.literal: Henceforth new graduates, when the court-audience day arrives, are to be carefully re-examined by the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: Henceforth new jinshi must pass a careful Secretariat review on court-audience day.

sentences.zh: 陝州奏，木連理。

translations.literal: Shan prefecture reported trees growing with conjoined trunks.
translations.idiomatic: Shan reported conjoined trees.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，中書侍郎兼工部尚書、平章事趙光胤卒，廢朝三日。

translations.literal: On gengyin, Secretariat Vice Director, concurrent Minister of Works, and co-equal chief minister Zhao Guangyin died; court was suspended three days.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin Zhao Guangyin, Secretariat vice director and chief minister, died; court mourned three days.

sentences.zh: 六月癸亥，雲州上言，去年契丹從磧北歸帳，達靼因相掩擊，其首領於越族帳自磧北以部族羊馬三萬來降，已到南界，今差使人來赴闕奏事。

translations.literal: Sixth month, guihai: Yun prefecture reported that last year, when the Khitan returned from north of the desert to their tents, the Tatars attacked one another; the chief Yuyue's clan brought tribes, sheep, and horses numbering thirty thousand to submit from north of the desert, had reached the southern frontier, and now sent envoys to court to report.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai in the sixth month Yun reported that after the Khitan returned north, Tatars fought; Chief Yuyue brought 30,000 head of tribe, sheep, and horse to the border and sent envoys to court.

sentences.zh: 甲子，太白晝見。

translations.literal: On jiazi Venus appeared in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi Venus shone by day.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，以滄州節度使安元信充北面行營馬步軍都排陣使。

translations.literal: On dingmao, Cangzhou military commissioner An Yuanxin was made northern campaign army horse-and-foot array marshal.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao An Yuanxin of Cang became northern array marshal.

sentences.zh: 辛未，以宗正卿李紓充昭宗、少帝改卜園陵使。

translations.literal: On xinwei Director of the Imperial Clan Li Shu was made commissioner for relocating the mausoleums of Zhaozong and the Young Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei Li Shu of the Imperial Clan was made mausoleum-relocation commissioner for Zhaozong and the Young Emperor.

sentences.zh: 壬申，京師雨足。

translations.literal: On renshen the capital had sufficient rain.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen the capital had enough rain.

sentences.zh: 自是大雨，至於九月，晝夜陰晦，未嘗澄霽，江河漂溢，堤防壞決，天下皆訴水災。

translations.literal: From then great rain fell until the ninth month; day and night were overcast and never cleared; rivers overflowed and dikes burst; the realm all cried flood disaster.
translations.idiomatic: Then floods ran until the ninth month—endless gloom, rivers bursting dikes, and flood cries everywhere.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，詔吳越王錢鏐將行冊禮，準禮文合用竹冊，宜令所司修製玉冊。

translations.literal: On dingchou an edict: when King Qian Liu of Wu-Yue was to undergo enfeoffment rites, the ritual texts called for bamboo tablets; the responsible offices should instead prepare jade tablets.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou an edict ordered jade tablets instead of bamboo for Qian Liu's Wu-Yue enfeoffment rites.

sentences.zh: 時郭崇韜秉政，以為不可，樞密承旨段徊讚其事，故有是命。

translations.literal: Guo Chongtao then held power and thought it improper; Chief Secretary expositor Duan Hui praised the affair, hence the order.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Chongtao opposed it, but expositor Duan Hui urged it, and the order stood.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，以天德軍節度使、管內蕃漢都知兵馬使劉承訓為天德軍節度觀察留後。

translations.literal: On guichou, Tiande army military commissioner and circuit-wide Han-and-barbarian commander Liu Chengchun was made Tiande military and surveillance acting commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou Liu Chengchun of Tiande became acting Tiande commissioner.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，詔曰：「關內諸陵，頃因喪亂，例遭穿穴，多未掩修。

translations.literal: On bingxu, an edict said: "The tombs within the passes, in recent disorder, have commonly been tunneled and many are not yet repaired.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu an edict said, "Pass tombs, robbed in the troubles, lie open and unrepaired.

sentences.zh: 其下宮殿宇法物等，各令奉陵州府據所管陵園修製，仍四時各依舊例薦饗。

translations.literal: Underground palaces, halls, ritual objects, and the like are each to be restored by the tomb-keeping prefectures according to the tombs they oversee, with seasonal offerings as of old.
translations.idiomatic: Palaces, halls, and ritual goods are to be restored by tomb-keeping prefectures with seasonal rites as before.

sentences.zh: 每陵仰差近陵百姓二十戶充陵戶，以備灑掃。

translations.literal: For each tomb twenty households of nearby people are to be assigned as tomb households for sweeping.
translations.idiomatic: Each tomb gets twenty nearby households as tomb keepers for sweeping.

sentences.zh: 其壽陵等一十陵，亦一例修掩，量置陵戶。

translations.literal: The ten tombs including Shouling are likewise to be repaired and covered, with tomb households set as needed.
translations.idiomatic: Ten tombs including Shouling are likewise to be covered and staffed.

sentences.zh: 」戊子，以刑部尚書李琪充昭宗、少帝改卜園陵禮儀使。

translations.literal: 」On wuzi, Minister of Punishments Li Qi was made ritual commissioner for relocating the mausoleums of Zhaozong and the Young Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: 」On wuzi Li Qi of Punishments was made ritual commissioner for Zhaozong and the Young Emperor's tombs.

sentences.zh: 己丑，以工部郎中李途為京兆少尹，充修奉諸陵使。

translations.literal: On jichou, Works section director Li Tu was made Jingzhao junior intendant and charged as commissioner for repairing and maintaining the tombs.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou Li Tu of Works became Jingzhao junior intendant and tomb-repair commissioner.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，詔括天下私馬，

translations.literal: On xinmao, an edict ordered the seizure of private horses throughout the realm,
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao an edict ordered private horses seized empire-wide,

translations.literal: 〈Bracket note
translations.idiomatic: 〈Note

sentences.zh: （《五代會要》：詔下河南、河北諸州，和市戰馬，官吏除一匹外，匿者坐罪。）〉

translations.literal: (The 《Institutes of the Five Dynasties》: the edict went to Henan and Hebei prefectures to purchase war horses; officials might keep one each, and concealment was punishable.)〉
translations.idiomatic: (The 《Five Dynasties Institutes》 says Henan and Hebei were to buy war horses; officials kept one each, and hiding horses was a crime.)〉

sentences.zh: 將收蜀故也。

translations.literal: This was to prepare for taking Shu.
translations.idiomatic: The levy aimed at conquering Shu.

translations.literal: 〈Bracket note
translations.idiomatic: 〈Note

sentences.zh: （《三楚新錄》：莊宗謂高季興曰：「今天下負固不服者，惟吳、蜀耳。

translations.literal: (The 《New Record of the Three Chu》 says: Zhuangzong said to Gao Jixing, "Today those who still hold out against us are only Wu and Shu.
translations.idiomatic: (The 《New Record of the Three Chu》 says Zhuangzong told Gao Jixing, "Only Wu and Shu still defy us.

sentences.zh: 朕欲先有事於蜀，而蜀地險阻尤難，江南才隔荊南一水，朕欲先之，卿以為何如？

translations.literal: I wish to strike Shu first, yet Shu's terrain is especially hard; south of the Yangtze is only one river beyond Jingnan—should I strike there first? What do you think?"
translations.idiomatic: I would hit Shu first, though its passes are hardest; south of the Yangtze is only a river beyond Jingnan—should I strike Wu instead? What say you?"

sentences.zh: 」季興對曰：「臣聞蜀地富民饒，獲之可建大利；

translations.literal: Jixing replied: "I have heard Shu's land is rich and its people prosperous; taking it could build great profit;
translations.idiomatic: Jixing answered, "Shu is rich; its capture would bring great gain;

sentences.zh: 江南國貧，地狹民少，得之恐無益。

translations.literal: the southern state is poor, its land narrow and its people few—gaining it would likely bring no benefit.
translations.idiomatic: Wu is poor, narrow, and thin—little profit there."

sentences.zh: 臣願陛下釋吳先蜀。

translations.literal: I beg Your Majesty to set Wu aside and take Shu first."
translations.idiomatic: I beg Your Majesty to leave Wu and take Shu first."

sentences.zh: 」時莊宗意亦欲伐蜀，及聞季興之言，果大悅。）〉

translations.literal: At that time Zhuangzong also wished to attack Shu; hearing Jixing's words, he was greatly pleased.)〉
translations.idiomatic: Zhuangzong already favored Shu; Jixing's counsel delighted him.)〉
